text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—A perfect game. In order to pull that off 
consistently, the ability most needed 
right now is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's "explosive power."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
First, a good start. Without that, setting 
the pace is completely ruined.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Burst out, burst right out—the instant the 
signal sounds. I hate it, but I'll do it 
even if I have to change my daily 
habits...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ringgggg...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Waking up to the alarm clock—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Dash!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ruler?! What's gotten into you? You're 
always cutting it close! —All right, I 
won't lose either!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Once the lunch chime rings—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Dash!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Are you aiming for the yakisoba 
pan~?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I reach for their doorbell... No, let's 
not press it—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Dash!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And in training as well, of course. 
Trainer, are the gates ready?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright—let's do this. Until I get used to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang! Clang! Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you've gotten quite used to it. Late 
starts barely happen anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even this sound, reminiscent of an Iron 
Maiden— once you get used to hearing it, 
it's nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—the eve of the Mainichi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how about we open a "Sonic 
Diner"?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's a card game that tests your quick 
reflexes. You complete Chinese dish names 
using cards like "Raa," "Tan," and "Men."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I want my body to memorize instant 
reactions. Procedural memory, as they call 
it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Ra-""men"! "Tan-""men"! 
"Tan-""tan-""men"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Fried" "Rice"! "Shu" "Mai"! "Chashu" 
"Noodles"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that makes four wins in a row. Care 
for another game?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I might be a homebody, but that 
doesn't mean my reflexes are dull.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it... All five of my senses are 
being sharpened to their absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, preparations were completely 
finished.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is—perfection. If I can't run 
this race without a single flaw, then..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I could stand shoulder to 
shoulder with those three. The Classic 
Triple Crown is nothing but a pipe dream.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I can do it... If it's me... In gate 
training, I didn't have any late starts 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can't do it. I have to... 
be able to...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thick beads of sweat begin to form on her 
face... This is—a very bad sign.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it too much caused the 
impatience kept pent up inside to 
gradually surface...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Aargh, whatever, here goes! "RA" "MEN"!!
